subject: alternate method of indicating large set of variables are correlated

messages.author: 132c2bdf9eb37647
messages.subject: alternate method of indicating large set of variables are correlated
parts:
Hi,

I have a lot of variables, and I want to indicate that they are all correlated (for purposes of modeling non-random error).

Instead of listing out all the possible combinations, is there an easier way to do this? 

E.g., instead of listing all possible pairs of correlations....
var1 ~~ var2
var1 ~~ var3
var1 ~~ var4
var1 ~~ var5
var2 ~~ var3
var2 ~~ var4
....
....
....

The above is just an example, I have a lot more variables so it would be very time-consuming and error-prone if I do this by hand. 

Many thanks,
Angelita
